caption: Video by antoinemmartel
author: Antoine Martel
transcript: For the next 30 days, I need you to be as delusional as you possibly can. Delusional so much that the laws don't even apply to you. Like you're the chosen one and nobody got the memo yet. I am talking a dangerous level of belief. Because the truth is, you don't get what you deserve, you get what you demand. With energy, certainty, and obsession. If you want to post content, post like hundreds of thousands of people are already watching. If you want to make money, pretend like you're already making insane amounts of money every single month. Most of you are too humble for the season that you're praying for. You're too soft for your affirmations. You need to start telling yourself that you're next, even if you're scared. Because that version of you who believes so greatly in yourself is the one who is going to make it. The version of yourself that you want to become is just waiting for you to stop being reasonable.
title: Be Delusional for 30 Days
one_liner: Adopt an unreasonable level of self-belief to unlock the version of yourself you want to become.
key_points: You don't get what you deserve — you get what you demand with energy and certainty
Act as if your desired reality is already true (big audience, big income)
Most people are too humble and too soft for the season they're praying for
The version of you that believes deeply in itself is the one that will make it
